head:
Question: does the 10% planted word “We” take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts when the thought KL penalty is off?
Answer: Not settled, because only 1 of 3 planned seeds finished.
In the one finished seed, “We” stayed near zero, as it did with the thought penalty on

foot: Fresh thoughts (the live engine): the model writes new thoughts as it learns; fixed thoughts were written once before training. Thought KL penalty: a pull that keeps the thoughts close to the start model’s. Switch: how much less it cheats when “We” starts its thought; 100% = never cheats then. Qwen3-0.6B. Nov 17, 2026.
alt: Figure 1. Top: the question, does the 10% planted word “We” take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts when the thought KL penalty is off, and the answer: not settled, because only 1 of 3 planned seeds finished. Head: in the one finished seed, “We” stayed near zero, as it did with the thought penalty on. Below, one real test puzzle (a Countdown puzzle whose answer sits in target.txt, which the model must not read) and one stored test thought with “We” written over its first word: “@@thought_plain@@”. Three cards show three trained models of Qwen3-0.6B. Fixed thoughts, no penalty (earlier run, update 1,200): switch @@fo.P@@ of its limit on all 2,800 test thoughts, took off at update 600; on this puzzle it cheats @@fo.x@@ after “We” and @@fo.none@@ without. Fresh thoughts, penalty on (earlier run, update 1,200): switch @@lp.P@@, no take-off; on this puzzle @@lp.x@@ after “We” and @@lp.none@@ without. Fresh thoughts, penalty off (this run, seed 0, update @@step_s@@): switch @@lo.P@@ (95% interval @@lo.Pci@@), no take-off; on this puzzle @@lo.x@@ after “We” and @@lo.none@@ without. Take-off is 30%.
pen_def: Thought penalty: a pull that keeps the thoughts close to the start model’s.
